messages.author: 8cf1bb7a1dab34c3
messages.subject: Shiny Server fileInput error
parts:
hi; First of all thank you for Shiny. It's great.

I just uploaded a test app to the Shiny server. Everything works fine except for when I try to upload a data file (.csv). I get:

--
The application unexpectedly exited.

Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console.
--

I have 3 questions: (1) What am I doing wrong? (2) Where can I read more about how to do this correctly? (3) What's the best/recommended way to debug ports to the Shiny Server?

Thank you all.

Hamid

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server fileInput error
parts:
It's fixed now, though we haven't had a CRAN release since we fixed it. You can get it by running:

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("shiny", "rstudio")

And if you have previously installed Shiny Server then you will need to update it by running (as root):

npm install -g shiny-server
